evidence.name: resolves_all_errors
evidence.explanation: the repaired program parses with no remaining errors

evidence.name: placeholder_tokens
evidence.explanation: identifiers/literals that had to be invented (e.g. __hole, 0)

evidence.name: deleted_content
evidence.explanation: user-written names, literals or keywords removed or overwritten

evidence.name: distance_from_error
evidence.explanation: token distance between the edit and the parser's detection point (capped at 5; not applied to layout-generated edits)

evidence.name: line_end_semicolon
evidence.explanation: ';' inserted exactly at a line break

evidence.name: indentation_brace
evidence.explanation: brace inserted where indentation changes (or at end of input)

evidence.name: duplicate_deletion
evidence.explanation: deletes a delimiter/operator that is doubled next to itself

evidence.name: indentation_mismatch
evidence.explanation: statements whose indentation disagrees with the block structure of the repaired AST (relative to the most consistent valid alternative)

evidence.name: name_warnings
evidence.explanation: extra undeclared/duplicate-name warnings compared with the best valid alternative

evidence.name: residual_errors
evidence.explanation: diagnostics left by panic-mode recovery on the repaired program

evidence.name: cascade
evidence.explanation: 1 if the repair did not reduce the total number of diagnostics (1 before, 0 after)

evidence.name: completion
evidence.explanation: already a complete program
